items.title: General Motors Plans 20% Increase in Factory Automation by 2028 as Manufacturing Costs Rise
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) is planning to increase the use of robotics and other automated technologies across its North American manufacturing facilities by 20% by 2028, according to a Reuters report citing two people familiar with the company’s plans. The initiative comes as the US automaker seeks to manage higher labour expenses and costs associated with expanding domestic manufacturing operations.

items.title: Ford Paid Retirees a Bonus Dividend 2 Years Running. In 2026 It Didn’t. Will It Come Back?
items.summary: Ford's March checks grew fatter two years in a row, then the extra money vanished without a word of explanation. Cash flow, a rival's buyback, and a bleak 2027 outlook offer clues about whether income investors should keep waiting.
